04 EVIDENCE & DESIGN

What this demo can tell us.

Measured, not inferred

The waveform, pitch and energy traces are computed from supplied recordings. Pitch estimates are provisional. Sustained syllables, singer intention and emotion have not been annotated or established.

A careful comparison

Matching Chinese text is a retrieval rule, not proof of identical Yi lyrics or equivalent performances. Recording conditions, singers and source excerpts may differ.
